---
title: "phiz"
subtitle: "A ggplot2-flavored grammar of graphics for PHP that emits Vega-Lite"
---

Build charts in PHP with data, mappings, and layers. Render interactive charts with Vega-Lite or export static images.

{{< include _generated/index-hero.md >}}

phiz compiles each plot to a [Vega-Lite](https://vega.github.io/vega-lite/) specification, a JSON description of the chart. The browser draws it with vega-embed, and the [vl-convert](https://github.com/vega/vl-convert) binary renders it to SVG, PNG, or PDF. No JavaScript is written by hand.

## Install

```sh
composer require phpstats/phiz
```

phiz supports PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5 and has no required dependencies. Examples that use the pipe operator `|>` need PHP 8.5 and have a method-chain version for PHP 8.3 and 8.4. [Installation](get-started.qmd#installation) lists the optional pieces.

## The PHPstats family

phiz plots the tables and results of the other PHPstats packages: [phibble](https://github.com/phpstats/phibble) data frames, [phplyr](https://github.com/phpstats/phplyr) summaries, [phit](https://github.com/phpstats/phit) model fits, and [CmdStanPHP](https://github.com/phpstats/CmdStanPHP) draws. It depends on none of them.
